parsed.internal_thinking: I have placed my second settlement on node 14 (Wood 3, Wood 4, Wheat 8). Now I need to place the road. Looking at the options: 14-13 is blocked by Claude at node 12. 14-24 leads to node 25 (Ore 3, Wheat 8, Wood 3) or node 23 (Ore 3, Wood 3, Brick 10). 14-15 leads to node 16 (Ore port) and node 7 (Brick port). Given my high Ore/Wheat focus from my first settlement (node 42), the Ore port at node 16 is very attractive for long-term efficiency. However, getting towards node 25 or 23 helps secure more production. Node 24 itself is blocked for building, but it is a stepping stone. I will place the road towards node 24 to keep expansion options open towards the center and the 10-Brick at node 23.
parsed.note_to_self: Placed road 14-24. Planning to expand towards node 23 for Brick (10) or node 25 for more production. My Ore/Wheat engine is strong, so ports or Brick are the priority.
parsed.say_outloud: שמתי את הדרך לכיוון המשבצת של האבן. אולי נצליח להוציא משם משהו שיעזור לבנות קצת יותר מהר.
